lots.title: Positioning, structure and trust
lots.objective: Make MIRAVA understandable, trustworthy and actionable before visual polish.
lots.audit_prompt: Audit MIRAVA positioning and structure without modifying code. Validate the listed findings and stop before implementation.
lots.implementation_prompt: Use product-marketing, copywriting and ui-ux-pro-max. Clarify the target and mechanism, rewrite hero/CTA, move the process earlier and add truthful privacy reassurance. Do not invent proof.
lots.verification_prompt: Do not modify code. Compare new desktop/mobile captures with the original and classify every LOT-01 finding.
acceptance_criteria: Process appears in first four sections.
Privacy claims are truthful and close to upload.

lots.title: Visual system and AI-template reduction
lots.objective: Replace card monoculture with a proprietary editorial grammar.
lots.audit_prompt: Audit only component hierarchy, surfaces, radii, cadence and identity composition.
lots.implementation_prompt: Implement approved visual-system changes while preserving MIRAVA’s dark photographic identity.
lots.verification_prompt: Compare cadence, card count and identity balance at 1440 and 390.

lots.title: Asset diversity and evidence
lots.objective: Demonstrate range and credibility with non-repeated assets and real proof.
lots.audit_prompt: Inventory image families and available real proof without fabricating replacements.
lots.implementation_prompt: Replace repeated assets and add only verified proof.
lots.verification_prompt: Count repeated families and validate provenance.
acceptance_criteria: No hero asset reused as another primary visual.
At least three distinct use cases.

lots.title: Mobile readability and compression
lots.objective: Reduce mobile scroll fatigue while preserving the story.
lots.audit_prompt: Audit mobile at 390 and 360; measure current typography when URL exists.
lots.implementation_prompt: Compact mobile layouts, remove nonessential microcopy and preserve touch targets.
lots.verification_prompt: Run browser checks at 390 and 360 and inspect overflow, text, focus and flow.
acceptance_criteria: Primary CTA reached without redundant sections.
